label: PF Backlog 634
title: Gate 1 enforcement at the backlog transition: block new->in_progress when a design review has PENDING BLOCKER/MAJOR (grandfather legacy)

brief.problem: Gate 1 enforcement depends on a human running gate1_check; nothing machine-checks the new->in_progress (design approval) transition.
brief.what_adds: A precheck gate that inspects backlog item transitions and enforces clean Gate 1.5 dispositions for reviewed items.
brief.why: Binding gates must be machine-enforced at the transition point, not remembered.

objective: Machine-enforce Gate 1 at the backlog new->in_progress transition, with a legacy grandfather.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic precheck gate (scripts/dev/gate1_transition_check.py) detects items moved to in_progress in the change set and, when a design review exists, requires zero pending BLOCKER/MAJOR.
Items with no design review are allowed (legacy grandfather) and are reported as 'no design review' rather than failing.
The gate is wired into the precheck fast tier (_GATES) and config/ci-cd-gates.json stays in sync (ci-cd-gates gate passes).
A test covers pending BLOCKER/MAJOR -> fail, fully dispositioned -> pass, and no design evidence -> pass.
in_scope: Gate 1 enforcement at the backlog transition: block new->in_progress when a design review has PENDING BLOCKER/MAJOR (grandfather legacy)
approach: Gate 1 enforcement at the backlog transition: block new->in_progress when a design review has PENDING BLOCKER/MAJOR (grandfather legacy)
verification: gate1-transition precheck gate wired (precheck._GATES + ci-cd-gates registry); blocks new->in_progress with pending BLOCKER/MAJOR; legacy grandfathered; tests added.
precheck fast PASS (44 gates) + Gate 2.5 clean (0 findings) + pytest; PR #260 merged (0decb70f).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend the backlog status-transition handler (core/backlog.py, /api/v1/backlog/epics/{epic_id}/status and item-level status update) with a Gate 1 check modeled on merge_gate.py: before new->in_progress, query design_critic.py for the item's latest design review; block with a structured 409 listing pending BLOCKER/MAJOR review ids. Grandfather: items already in_progress (or in any post-new state) at deploy cutoff skip the check; only the new->in_progress edge is gated.
conflict_findings: Shares core/backlog.py transition path with BI-PF-1531 (status rework) - sequence or split files
Shares design review query logic with BI-PF-1526 - extract shared helper to avoid dup
duplication_findings: No existing backlog-transition gate in candidate components; merge_gate.py gates merges, not transitions
BI-PF-1526 (Gate 2 at reconciliation) is sibling work with same review-source, share helper
BI-PF-1531 reworks status states incl. in_review - must land compatible edge definitions
analysis.rationale: Small, high-leverage EXTEND: intercept one transition edge, reuse design review source and the established merge-gate refusal pattern; no new component. Medium confidence due to grandfather and no-review edge cases needing human decision.
assumptions: A design review exists as a persisted record queryable per backlog item via design_critic.py
PENDING BLOCKER/MAJOR means latest non-superseded review has unresolved blocker/major findings
Grandfather = snapshot at deploy: items already past 'new' at cutover are exempt forever
409-style structured refusal (no hard exception) matches existing API error conventions
risks: Grandfather cutoff semantics unclear - could wrongly block or wrongly allow legacy items
Gate may block legitimate hotfix work; needs documented override/escalation path
Design review may not exist at all for an item - block vs pass decision is ambiguous
Interaction with in_review state from BI-PF-1531 could make 'new' edge definition drift
evidence: core/merge_gate.py establishes the gate-then-structured-refusal pattern to mirror
core/design_critic.py holds design review data model and finding severity
config/ci-cd-gates.json shows declarative gate config precedent
missing_info: Grandfather cutoff: hard deploy-time snapshot vs rolling exempt list maintained in config?
Item has NO design review at all: block, warn, or auto-create review task (cf. BI-0183)?
Is there a manual override (role-gated force flag) for emergency in_progress?
Should the gate also apply to in_progress -> in_review or only the single edge (scoped as single edge)?

context_review.reason: Title states the rule (WHAT) but approach merely repeats it; no details on querying review status, grandfathering logic, or files/components (all 'Not specified')

api_impact.reason: process/tooling change: no external API surface (dev scripts + gates + docs).
